sprites.prompt: Middle-aged priest with calm authority, morena-clara skin, short grey hair, white-cream robes with gold-bordered details and high collar, small silver scales pendant on chain.
Analytical woman with controlled posture, olive skin, black hair in tight bun, slate-blue coat buttoned to the neck with bronze buttons, always carrying a ledger or clipboard.

Wood elf woman with bronze-copper skin leaning forward curiously, moss-brown braided hair with dried leaves and flowers, light green linen blouse over earth-toned shirt, leather belt with herb pouches.
Broad dwarf blacksmith, weathered tan skin with burn scars on palms, three thick grey braids with iron rings, heavy leather apron, arms disproportionately large from years at the forge.
Energetic halfling carpenter, light-brown skin, light-chestnut curly sideburns, enormous bare hairy feet caked in sawdust, vest with dozens of pockets stuffed with tools and notes.
Half-orc barrel-bodied bouncer, grey-red skin, prominent tusks from lower jaw, geometric clan tattoos on shoulders and arms, old combat scars, work shirt with sleeves rolled up, resting scowl.

Half-orc with grey-blue skin, small discreet tusks, eyes always scanning exits, shaved sides with a longer top lock tilted forward, heavy dark leather coat always buttoned, posture of someone waiting.

Goblin alchemist with orange-grey skin, vivid yellow eyes, wild blue hair spiked in all directions from an old experiment, leather apron covered in multicoloured stains, multiple bubbling vials dangling from belt.
Orc tavern owner with warm dark-green skin, strong visible tusks, thick red braid draped over one shoulder, worn red apron with work stains, powerful calloused hands, direct confident expression.

Copper draconite merchant with weathered dark-copper scales, pale-grey chest and neck plates, short chipped horns, amber vertical-slit eyes, travel cloak with hood down, heavy boots, explorer belt, tail with faint scars.

Night elf woman with midnight-blue skin trying to blend in, extremely fine silver-white straight hair, violet faintly glowing eyes, subtle constellation tattoos on neck and forearms, deliberately plain brown-beige common city clothing.

Ninrorin grey-elf scholar with pale grey skin, ice-blue eyes, straight silver hair to shoulders, cobalt-blue tunic with geometric silver embroidery at borders, perfectly erect posture, always holding a scroll or book.
Dwarf miner-warrior, bronzed skin, black hair with natural white streaks, short braided beard with copper ring, reinforced leather breastplate and metal bracers, pickaxe worn on back like a weapon.

Young halfling boy with pale skin and freckles, wild red hair, enormous golden-furred bare feet, a worn leather backpack clearly too large for him tilting him backward, animated money-savvy expression.
City guard knight, sun-bronzed skin, neatly trimmed brown hair and beard, clear green eyes mixing caution and openness, slate-blue half-armour with Kanthor shield-and-stars emblem on right shoulder.

Tailor using her own outfit as portfolio, brown skin, curly dark hair with coloured fabric ribbon samples woven in, expressive eyes, precisely tailored structured garments, measuring tape worn as necklace.

Goblin merchant with orange-grey skin, too-wide smile with many teeth, half-shut calculating-friendly yellow eyes, quality-fabric merchant shirt, many-buttoned vest, small hat slightly tilted, conspicuously harmless appearance.

Half-elf animal keeper with outdoor-bronzed skin, barely pointed ears easy to miss, amber patient eyes, long brown hair tied with a green cord, simple practical green-and-brown work clothes with grass stains, small animal often nearby.

Musician with golden-fair skin with subtle shimmer highlights, wavy dark-brown hair loose and free, unusual blue eyes for a Dornecan, light colourful flowing fabric clothes, always mid-hum with soft expression.

Short stocky innkeeper, fair skin, thinning brown hair neatly but unsuccessfully combed, short symmetrical moustache, gentle eyes, white shirt and dark vest under a dirty-beige apron, jangling key-ring on belt.

Green draconita herbalist with dark-green scales and irregular olive patches like a forest snake, gold-yellow vertical-slit eyes, short backward-curving soft horns, fine long tail used for balance, herb-pocket apron over linen tunic.

Tiny gnome archivist, rosy-clear skin, perfectly parted brown hair, enormous round golden-framed spectacles magnifying his already large eyes, dark-blue vest with a different ink-stamp in each dedicated pocket, long agile fingers.

Night elf man with charcoal-grey skin darker than Yael, deep blue-black hair, silver reflective eyes, linear constellation tattoos on neck, closed unreadable expression, dark explorer clothing, appears rarely.

Tiefling fisherman with blue-grey skin, small backward-curving discrete horns, thin pointed tail touching the water when seated, black hair always damp and tied back, solid amber eyes gazing at water surfaces, waxed green-grey fishing oilskin coat with shoulder-slung net.

Robust warm-brown baker with flushed rosy cheeks from the oven, brown hair wrapped in a red-earth kerchief with loose flour-dusted strands, white flour-stained apron over a warm-brown dress, dish cloth on shoulder, idle animation shakes a puff of flour from her apron.

Very old draconato tanner with matte opaque earth-brown scales stripped of all sheen by decades of tannin, heavy blunt snout, pale amber slow-blinking eyes, short lashed back horns with chipped tips, thick dragging tail, enormous calloused hands, stiff dark tannin-blackened apron, idle caresses a stretched hide.

Pale small gnome acolyte who actually works nights as a gravedigger, enormous dark eyes with deep purple shadows, fine grey-brown slightly dishevelled hair, oversized white acolyte tunic with hem always caked in graveyard earth, thick dripping candle in hand with hardened wax on fingers, hidden black-luna pendant beneath collar.

Very old Ninrorin grey-elf village elder, pale grey wrinkled skin with pixel-wrinkle lines at brow and eyes, long white-grey straight hair and beard falling to chest, heavy white brows, deep amber weary eyes with slow lids, long grey-blue civic mantle with silver Kanthor-scales fibula, leans on gnarled oak staff as genuine support.
Generic human NPC archetype, neutral warm skin tone, rounded ears, varied trade clothing appropriate to occupation, readable expression at 32px scale.
Generic elf NPC archetype, cool-fair skin, pointed ears 5-6px above head line, slightly almond eyes, long or braided hair, slender silhouette.
Generic tiefling NPC archetype, purple-grey unusual skin, small curved horns from head, visible thin pointed tail behind body, solid irises with no visible white, ordinary city clothing.
Generic halfling NPC archetype, warm fair skin, slightly pointed wide ears, curly hair, disproportionately large hairy bare feet, colourful clothing with many pockets, naturally jovial expression.
Generic goblin NPC archetype, grey-green skin, large head relative to body, long protruding nose, tattered-leather scraps clothing, large amber-yellow eyes, ragged pointed ears.

Generic dwarf NPC archetype, rosy-dark skin, extremely wide shoulders nearly as broad as sprite height, thick layered beard, heavy work apron, large hands, metal buckles, serious practical expression.
Generic orc NPC archetype, medium-green skin with deep shadow variation, visible lower tusks, broad hunched-forward shoulders, heavy brow, deep-set eyes, imposing silhouette among other NPCs.

Generic draconito NPC archetype, copper-toned scales with diagonal pixel texture suggesting scale pattern, short prominent snout, vertical-slit eyes, short backward horns, visible short tail, elegant yet imposing posture.
Generic child NPC, slightly oversized head in proportion, short legs, fast and clumsy movement, simple patched colourful clothing, curious open expression.
Tabby cat in Stardew Valley style, compact oval body, round head, triangular ears, long curved tail, orange base with dark-brown stripes and cream belly, idle animation: ear flick or tail sway.

Medium caramel-coloured dog, fluffy coat, floppy or upright ears depending on breed, short friendly snout, tongue out in idle-happy animation, always-wagging tail, caramel coat with cream muzzle and paws.
